mobile_photo_upload.problem: Receipt photos from mobile (3-5MB) exceeded Next.js default 1MB body limit
mobile_photo_upload.solution: Add export const config = { api: { bodyParser: { sizeLimit: '10mb' } } }
mobile_photo_upload.pattern: Always increase body size limit for endpoints accepting base64 images

price_per_litre_calculation.problem: VLM-extracted price/L may not match due to receipt rounding
price_per_litre_calculation.solution: Always calculate price/L from amount/litres for accuracy
price_per_litre_calculation.pattern: const pricePerLitre = amountRand / litres; // Never trust VLM for derived values

fuel_efficiency_calculation.problem: L/100km was using date-based previous lookup, could be wrong order
fuel_efficiency_calculation.solution: Use odometer-based lookup: find highest odometer < current odometer
fuel_efficiency_calculation.pattern: WHERE odometer_reading < ${currentOdometer} ORDER BY odometer_reading DESC LIMIT 1

recalculate_on_delete.problem: Deleting transactions leaves stale L/100km values on remaining entries
recalculate_on_delete.solution: After delete, recalculate all entries: first entry = null, subsequent = (litres/km_diff)*100
recalculate_on_delete.pattern: ORDER BY odometer_reading ASC, first entry NULL, loop through rest calculating from previous

admin_delete_pattern.problem: Need to restrict delete to admin/super_admin only
admin_delete_pattern.solution: Check user.role in API handler before allowing delete
admin_delete_pattern.pattern: const user = (req as unknown as { user?: { role?: string } }).user; if (user?.role !== 'admin' && user?.role !== 'super_admin') return forbidden;

odometer_stats_consistency.problem: Distance Travelled card showed different 'Latest' km than Odometer Tracking section
odometer_stats_consistency.root_cause: Stats API used fleet_check_records (with bad data 197,484 km) while Odometer Tracking used fleet_odometer_history (correct 167,686 km)
odometer_stats_consistency.solution: Changed stats API to use fleet_odometer_history as single source of truth
odometer_stats_consistency.pattern: SELECT MAX(reading) as latest_reading FROM fleet_odometer_history WHERE vehicle_id = $1

fuel_transaction_odometer_sync.problem: Fuel transaction odometer readings not reflected in odometer history stats
fuel_transaction_odometer_sync.solution: When fuel transaction is created with odometer, also insert into fleet_odometer_history
fuel_transaction_odometer_sync.pattern: INSERT INTO fleet_odometer_history (vehicle_id, reading, source, ...) VALUES (..., 'fuel_transaction', ...)
